description: This Java class 'PasswordSecret' encapsulates password credential secrets, including hash function, password hash, plain password, and salt. It provides methods for setting, encoding, and validating these secrets, and is part of the org.eclipse.hono.service.management.credentials package.

classes.name: PasswordSecret
classes.description: A class representing password secrets with fields for hash function, password hash, plain password, and salt, including validation and encoding methods.

methods.name: getHashFunction
methods.description: Returns the hash function used for password hashing.

methods.name: setHashFunction
methods.description: Sets the cryptographic hash function for the password secret.

methods.name: getSalt
methods.description: Returns the salt used in hashing.

methods.name: checkValidity
methods.description: Validates the secret's fields, ensuring required fields are set and plain password is empty.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes the plain password into hash and salt using the provided encoder, then clears the plain password.
